title: verdict.json — the canonical record of one suggest-security-patches run

base.description: The commit every reviewed byte applies to.

patchSha256.description: SHA-256 of patch.diff, tying the reviewed bytes to the artifact and the PR change.

reviewedDiffSha256.description: SHA-256 of the change as it stood when review began. Equal to patchSha256 on a written patch; a run where they could differ is stopped rather than published.

claims.description: Review confidence only. Never a statement that runtime behaviour was checked.

untested.description: Always true: this workflow runs no tests.

testsRun.description: Always the same sentence, kept separate from review confidence.

changedPaths.description: The engine's Git-derived changed set, in name-status form.
